cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I haven't approved these minutes. 'Discussion of my proposal' leaves out what happened to my name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dinner is deferred. Who is 'nobody'? Name the person who wanted me out of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That admission is noted. The minutes stay unsigned until you name the replacement too. I won't approve a rescue with the rescuer still missing.

reason: Use the actual signature and dinner permissions as gates to the careful answers, with B replacement omission causing the final specific demand.
